page.overview:
Who is Kit Revster?

"Sometimes Kit Revster can be found waxing and renting surfboards at the beach. More often he can be found closing early and hitting the waves but not today. This morning Kit's closed his surf shop for something truly special, the biggest race of the decade at the Los Angeles International Speedway."
